items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Then we had a trombone player in the band, too, named Leon White

ctx.x: Alex Hill was in the band after... Let me get this straight. L.Z. Cooper was in the band first, and then Mutt fired him or something, for some reason got rid of him, and then Alex Hill came in the band. Then we had a trombone player in the band, too, named Leon White, and then he left the band, and then we got a guy named Parker Berry, who was a very good trombone player.
So it was six pieces, in other words.
